'''Denon''', a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located between [[Osarian]] and [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]], was an [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] world, with city growth covering the entire surface, similar to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Description==
Denon was at the confluence of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]].<ref name="TEA" /> Denon was a heavily populated world that rose to prominence during the rule of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TUF" /> In terms of being an [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> it was [[Coruscant of the Outer Rim|second]] only to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
===Pre-Republic era===
The planet was a former colony of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] in the [[Pre-Republic era]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Old Republic era===
{{Quote|We were holding territory on Denon. Locals rioted, and orders were to open fire until they stopped. None of us even wanted to be there.. massacring civilians? That's not how Zakuul is supposed to operate.|[[Koth Vortena]]|<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Vanishing Acts}}</ref>}}
Denon joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] early in its history, sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], it supported Coruscant.<ref name="TEGtW" />

[[File:Denon_Exosphere_loading_screen.png|thumb|left|250px|Battle in Denon exosphere during the [[Galactic War]].]]
During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the planet was the site of a [[Battle of the Denon system|battle]] won by the Republic. The Galactic Republic was once again [[Battle of Denon (Jedi Civil War)|victorious]] at Denon during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Galactic War]], Denon exosphere was the site of [[Battle of Denon (Galactic War)|skirmishes]] between Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] forces.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]''</ref> Around the same time, the money reserves of 30 of Denon's most important [[Company/Legends|companies]] vanished without a trace. This apparent mass embezzlement was later investigated.<ref name="Mission" />

Several years later, during the [[Eternal Empire]] [[Eternal Empire conquest|campaign of conquest]] of the galaxy, Denon was [[Occupation of Denon|invaded and occupied]]. Riots soon erupted in the population and Captain [[Koth Vortena]] and his troops were ordered to fire on civilians.<ref name="KotFE" /> Millennia later, Denon was successfully [[Battle of Denon (New Sith Wars)|defended]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the final decades of the Galactic Republic, investors from Denon and the nearby planet [[Ardru]] created the [[Denon-Ardru Mutual]], a powerful [[Mining/Legends|mining]] and refinery corporation known for its tyrannical methods.<ref name="Obi-Wan" /> Denon was where [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] trained to become an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], and was the location of a murder trial against [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Evazan]], though he ultimately escaped from the courtroom.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Second Army|2nd Sector Army]] was in charge of defending the vital [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] junction at Denon.<ref name="TEGtW" />

===Galactic Civil War===
Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was considered a loyal world that sought to improve its position within the Empire.<ref name="AOR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Denon had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. The planet was liberated by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after a savage [[Battle of Denon (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Puck Naeco/Legends|Puck Naeco]] and Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] were natives to Denon.<ref name="TEGtW" />

The world was a New Republic stronghold during the [[Hunt for Zsinj|Zsinj]] and [[Thrawn campaign]]s but surrendered to the Empire during [[Operation Shadow Hand]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Later history===
A New Republic stronghold during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Denon was not attacked by the invaders.<ref name="TEA" /> The planet was later adopted as the temporary capital of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] following the resolution of the war in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="TUF" /><ref name="TCSWE" /> Denon was chosen as the new galactic headquarters due to the fact that it had escaped the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invasion unscathed, and thanks to its proximity to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. By [[30 ABY/Legends|30 ABY]], Coruscant had become the galactic capital once more.

Following the Yuuzhan Vong War, the [[House Vahali/Legends|Vahali family]], which had fled [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]] during [[Operation Shadow Hand]], regained wealth and importance on Denon.<ref name="Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>
